trigger_token.description: The single trigger the server posts; never chosen per call.

trigger_events.description: Pull-request events the bot subscribes to.

trigger_semantics.description: comment_trigger: the server posts trigger_token as the operator via the App (the user access token of a GitHub App credential, never the App's bot identity). auto_on_push: the bot reviews every push on its own (used for a bot that acts on no trigger comment); the server never posts a trigger for it, and trigger-based remedies escalate.

participation_markers.description: Anchored (start-of-block or structural) patterns, each with the sample size it was validated on.

participation_requires_update.description: Exempts no bot from the review currency test, which applies to every required bot.

refusal_size_patterns.description: Number-free detection patterns of a size refusal (cause size).

refusal_size_cap_patterns.description: Extraction patterns reading the ceiling the size refusal notice states (files or diff characters), recorded with the refusal; no ceiling is encoded in a pattern.

no_new_commits_patterns.description: Anchored patterns of the bot's 'Review skipped: No new commits' notice.

no_new_commits_class.description: Classification of that notice for a bot without trigger_verbs.full; a bot with a full verb always resolves refused with mode no_unreviewed_commit.

rate_interval_seconds.description: Window length after a claim when the bot publishes no parseable ETA; null applies the compiled rate-window floor (timeouts.adoc, Review-Bot Rate Windows).

attempt_ceiling.description: Maximum triggers per (repository, pr_number, bot_kind); compiled default 6 (timeouts.adoc, Review-Bot Rate Windows).

structural_caps.description: Ceilings for the pre-wait cap gate; null in every compiled-in record (a bot's ceilings are read from its notice), declared only by a team record that knows its bot's plan.
